tested_intervention.name: BETA_ONLY_POSITION_SIZING
tested_intervention.formula: clip(1/max(1, downside_beta_252d if available else beta_252d), 0.50, 1.00)

interpretation: Beta/downside-beta observability remains useful for warnings, diversification diagnostics and stress context. The pre-registered mechanical beta-only sizing rule failed both OOS promotion periods because expectancy and risk-adjusted performance deteriorated; it must not be activated or tuned post hoc.
limitations: Current-universe survivorship bias remains in the equal-weight PEA Action benchmark and ETF universe.
This validates only the marginal beta-only sizing hypothesis on the historical ETF MT 38-dynamic-PIT core; it does not certify the 43-criterion composite or full 268-criterion referential.
Sequence max drawdown is based on trade outcomes in signal order, not a timestamped multi-position portfolio NAV.
Economic-engine overlap, exact ETF holdings overlap and sector correction sizing remain shadow because historical PIT snapshots are incomplete.
